st: How to spend August thinking about a fortissimo future

sec.p: Catherine Price is an American journalist and writer. I discovered her recently in some podcast lost in the digital maze.
Then there are two little reads of reports or forecasts on the future (in climate and tech) that I'm keen to share.
Reading is great, but listening even more so. Like, I think, many of you, podcasts are now part of my daily life (especially when I cycle to work, combining productive and healthy time).

sec.t: ff.31.4 Four reflections on self-improvement and reaching big goals
sec.p: And now four somewhat scattered, somewhat motivational quotes.

sec.t: ff.31.5 Five tips for the summer
